errors.guildOnly: This command only works in a server.

errors.missingPermissionsUnknown: Discord refused the action: I am missing a permission, or my role is below the target's. Check my permissions and move my role higher in Server Settings > Roles.
errors.missingAccess: I cannot access this channel. Check that I can view it and send messages in it.
errors.hierarchy: You cannot act on this member: their highest role is equal to or above yours.
errors.botHierarchy: I cannot act on this member: their highest role is equal to or above mine.
errors.userNotFound: Member not found on this server.
errors.dmClosed: Could not send a direct message to this member (DMs closed).
errors.unknownCommand: This command no longer exists. It will disappear from the list shortly.
errors.moduleDisabled: The {module} module is disabled on this server.
errors.rateLimited: Discord is rate limiting requests right now. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.commandsDisabled: The command system is disabled on this server.
errors.cmdDisabled: Command {cmd} is disabled on this server.
errors.noRole: You need one of these roles to use this command: {roles}
errors.wrongChannel: This command only works in the following channels: {channels}

console.missingToken:
DISCORD_TOKEN is empty.
  1. Open https://discord.com/developers/applications and pick your application (or create one).
  2. "Bot" tab > "Reset Token", copy the token.
  3. Copy .env.example to .env and paste the token after DISCORD_TOKEN=.
  4. Start the bot again with npm start.
console.invalidToken: Discord rejected the token (DISCORD_TOKEN is invalid or was reset). Generate a new one in the Developer Portal ("Bot" tab > "Reset Token") and replace it in .env.
console.ready: Logged in as {tag}, present on {guilds} server(s).
console.registerMissingAccess: Discord refused to register commands on server {guild}. Check that GUILD_ID is correct and that the bot was invited with the "applications.commands" scope (use the invite link above).
console.tooManyCommands: {count} commands loaded, but Discord accepts at most {max}. Remove a module (delete its folder in src/modules) to stay under the limit.
console.disallowedIntents:
Some "Privileged Gateway Intents" are not enabled for this bot: {intents}.
  1. Open https://discord.com/developers/applications and pick your application.
  2. Go to the "Bot" tab.
  3. Under "Privileged Gateway Intents", enable: {intents}.
  4. Click "Save Changes", then restart the bot.
console.degraded: Meanwhile the bot starts without these intents. Inactive features: {features}.

intentFeatures.GuildMembers: joins and leaves (welcome, antiraid, autorole, verification, member logs)
intentFeatures.MessageContent: reading message content (automod, banned words, auto-responder, message logs)

console.dryRun: DRY_RUN mode: {modules} modules, {commands} commands, {events} events, {components} components. Command JSON: {size} KB. No connection to Discord.
